tabs.html:
VSOL V1600GT 2-Port GPON OLT – High-Performance Optical Line Terminal for Scalable Fiber Networks

The V1600GT 2-Port GPON OLT is a compact, high-speed optical line terminal (OLT) designed for fiber-to-the-home (FTTH) and fiber-to-the-premises (FTTP) deployments. Engineered for network scalability, this OLT is ideal for ISPs, telecom providers, and enterprise fiber networks, delivering stable, high-bandwidth GPON connectivity with flexible uplink options.


Key Features 

  • Versatile GPON Uplink – Equipped with 2 x GE (RJ45) ports and 2 x GE (SFP)/10GE (SFP+) ports, ensuring fast and flexible network expansion.
  • Compact & Space-Saving Design – With a lightweight build of 2.485kg, the V1600GT is ideal for small network installations and data centers.
  • Reliable Network Performance – Supports high-speed GPON connections, providing low-latency, stable data transmission for broadband, VoIP, and IPTV services.
  • Energy-Efficient & Cost-Effective – Designed for low power consumption, making it an economical choice for long-term deployments.


Technical Specifications

  • Model: V1600GT
  • GPON Uplink: 2 x GE (RJ45) + 2 x GE (SFP) / 10GE (SFP+)
  • Chassis: Compact, rack-mountable design
  • Weight: 2.485kg
  • Power Supply: AC 100-240V / DC -36V to -75V
  • Operating Temperature: -20°C to +60°C
  • Storage Temperature: -40°C to +70°C
  • Relative Humidity: 5%–95% (non-condensing)

Ideal Applications

  • FTTH / FTTP Deployments – Delivers high-speed fiber broadband for residential and business users.
  • Enterprise & Campus Networks – Supports high-bandwidth applications for corporate and educational institutions.
  • ISP & Telecom Networks – A cost-effective solution for expanding GPON services.
  • Smart City & IoT Infrastructure – Ensures reliable, high-speed connectivity for IoT and surveillance networks.


Why Choose the V1600GT GPON OLT?

  • Compact & Lightweight – Easy to install, rack-mountable, and optimized for space efficiency.
  • High-Speed Data Transmission – Supports GE and 10GE uplinks for scalable fiber networks.
  • Cost-Effective & Power-Efficient – Designed to reduce operational costs while maintaining network reliability.
  • Future-Proof Fiber Connectivity – Ensures seamless network expansion with GPON technology.
